<observations>
Date: Mar 2, 2026
* 🔴 User building "Ledgerly", a TypeScript invoicing SaaS for Canadian freelancers; database schema `ledgerly_core`; teammate Priyanka Vashisht reviews DB migrations; prefers VSCode linting extensions.
* ✅ Initialized TS project, implemented PDF invoice generation (PDFKit) with Jest unit tests.

Date: Mar 5, 2026
* 🔴 Added JWT authentication, GitHub Actions CI workflow, standard-version releases, and Stripe payment stub.
* ✅ JWT auth, CI pipeline, and release scripts successfully implemented and tested.

Date: Mar 8, 2026
* 🔴 Implemented audit logging (Winston) streaming to Loggly; target coverage 85%+.
* ✅ Audit logger integrated into invoice rendering; test coverage reached 87%.

Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🔴 Production Postgres runs in Frankfurt; added Prometheus monitoring.
* ✅ Merged PDF generation branch; added QR codes, `GET /invoices/:id/pdf` endpoint, and README docs.

Date: Mar 15, 2026
* 🔴 Added Handlebars email notifications for invoice delivery confirmations.
* ✅ Containerized app with Docker (`v1.3.0-staging` pushed to GHCR) and deployed to staging.

Date: Mar 19, 2026
* 🔴 User stated preference for `pnpm` over `npm` for all package installation commands.
* ✅ Installed Cypress (smoke tests passed), added Sentry error tracking, `/health` endpoint, and rate-limiting middleware (`express-rate-limit`) on PDF download endpoint.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Preparing for end-to-end testing of the invoice flow on staging using Cypress.
- Note: User mandates `pnpm` for all future package manager commands.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to review the Cypress end-to-end test results or provide further instructions.
</suggested-response>
